recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a man with dark features and stubble, cropped tightly to show only a portion of the face, paired with a single line of lowercase sans-serif text separated by forward slashes.
coreVisualRelationships: The tight crop creates an intimate connection with the viewer.
The text is placed over the cheek area, creating a contrast between skin texture and clean vector lines.
The olive-green background complements the warm skin tones and light blue denim.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is scaled to fill the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye (viewer's left) serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye leads downward to the lips, then horizontally across to the text on the cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A flat olive-green field occupies the upper right quadrant.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and brown skin tones define the primary palette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted olive-green background provides a cool-toned contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue denim in the lower right corner adds a bright highlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a focus on subtle tonal gradations in skin texture.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slashes used as structural bookends and separators

typesetting.alignment: centered horizontally relative to the text block

composition.position: middle right, overlaid on the subject's cheek

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all elements to maintain minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Precise geometry and excellent legibility at small sizes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail, extreme close-up portrait of a man with dark hair and stubble. Crop the face so the left eye is prominent and the right side of the head is cut off. The man should wear a light blue denim shirt. The background should be a solid, muted olive-green.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase sans-serif text in the middle-right area, positioned over the cheek. Use forward slashes to separate words and at the beginning and end of the string.

verificationChecks: Are there forward slashes at the start, middle, and end?
Is the crop tight enough to cut off the top of the head and one side of the face?
Is the background a muted olive-green?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the olive background
Exact placement of the text block
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist's name or album title.
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the celebrity.

avoid: Heavy shadows that obscure the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the skin tone.
Check that the lighting is soft and even across the face.
Confirm the denim texture is visible in the lower corner.
Verify the slashes are the same height as the lowercase letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme facial crop + muted earth-tone background + lowercase sans-serif text with slash delimiters.
